title: Kano air disaster
summary: A Boeing 707 crashed at Kano International Airport while attempting to land in high winds. The aircraft landed nose wheel first and the nose wheel collapsed after hitting a depression in the runway. The right main landing gear subsequently collapsed, the aircraft turned 180 degrees, left the runway and burst into flames. All 176 fatalities were a result of the fire.
probable_cause: The Nigerian government concluded pilot error caused the crash by flying the aircraft in a reckless manner in high wind conditions. The nose wheel collapsed after hitting a runway depression.

factors.evidence: Kano International Airport was experiencing high winds at the time.
The aircraft landed nose wheel first, and the nose wheel collapsed after hitting a depression in the runway.
The right main landing gear leg subsequently collapsed and the aircraft left the runway.
The aircraft burst into flames and all fatalities were a result of the fire.

events.text: The pilots had to make a second landing attempt due to low visibility from haze and a harmattan.
The aircraft landed nose wheel first, and the nose wheel collapsed after hitting a depression in the runway.
The right main landing gear leg subsequently collapsed and the aircraft turned 180 degrees and left the runway.
The aircraft burst into flames and all fatalities were a result of the fire.

title: Libyan Arab Airlines 114
summary: Libyan Arab Airlines Flight 114, a Boeing 727, was shot down on February 21, 1973 by two Israeli F-4 fighter jets while over the Sinai Peninsula. The aircraft had become lost due to bad weather and equipment failure over northern Egypt, inadvertently entering Israeli-controlled airspace. After being intercepted by Israeli fighters, the crew was unable to receive or understand landing instructions, and the aircraft was shot down by Israeli pilot authorization.
probable_cause: The aircraft was shot down by Israeli fighter aircraft. The crew had become lost due to combination of bad weather, equipment failure, and navigation error, causing the aircraft to enter Israeli-controlled airspace where it was intercepted and shot down on authorization from Israeli military command.
